description: This source file contains server-side logic for a page that manages organization selection and retrieval of the user's organizations via a Django REST API, including handling the organization switch action.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches and returns the list of organizations associated with the current user by calling the Django REST API endpoint, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: selectOrg
methods.description: Handles the organization selection process, updates authentication tokens with the new organization context, and redirects the user accordingly.
